text:
emi: FYI the release pipeline flagged a breaking change in the TS SDK from today's regen but it's just description/enum-doc shuffling in the OpenAPI spec
ci-bot: publish-gate: api-diff detected (PR #7942) - see https://ci.internal/diffs/7942. Classified as 'BREAKING' by changelogify
ryan: gah. I saw that — the generator treats any enum value description change as a diff to the type union ordering, even though runtime JSON values are unchanged
pierre: that's because changelogify compares raw schema AST nodes, and description fields live on the same node as the enum values. It flags the node as modified
emi: sampleapp-ts tests are red though; it's blocking the package publish for org users
ryan: quick mitigation: add a post-regendiff sanitizer that clears description/summary fields before diffing. Pseudocode I used locally:
```
# tools/changelogify/sanitize.py
def sanitize_schema(node):
    if 'description' in node: del node['description']
    if 'summary' in node: del node['summary']
    for child in node.get('properties', {}).values():
        sanitize_schema(child)
    for item in node.get('items', []):
        sanitize_schema(item)
```
emi: that would reduce noise. we should be conservative: only strip docs for the diff classifier, not from artifacts we ship
release-bot: publish-gate: current policy = auto-fail on any breaking-classified diff. creating ticket TICKET-4402 to add "diff-sanitizers" and manual-override in the console
ryan: alternative short-term: add a rule 'ignore-description-only' in changelogify config and rerun regen to see if the diff goes away
pierre: +1. I'll prototype in a branch and upload a hardened diff filter. also adding an integration test: mutate only descriptions and assert changelogify marks the API as identical
emi: can we also tweak the changelog generator to include a small summary: "diffs ignored for docs-only changes" so release engineers aren't confused
devx-bot: note: added label devex/regendiff-doc-noise to PR #7942
ryan: plan: pierre -> PR with sanitizer + test by EOD, emi -> open release playbook entry about manual override, pierre/ryan -> if CI still flags, we'll do emergency revert of the typegen change
emi: assigning: @pierre on patch, @ryan on test harness, @emi on release docs. watching the sampleapp-ts pipeline now
ci-bot: update: sanitized-regendiff artifact uploaded for branch/pierre/sanitize-diff (api-diff now classified as NON-BREAKING)
emi: excellent. once CI stays green we can unhold the publish and add a small changelog note: "chore: reduce changelog noise from description-only OpenAPI edits"
ryan: will also add a tiny note in the sdk/README about how description edits are treated and how to avoid accidental publish blocks
emi: thanks team, keeping this thread as the single place to coordinate the fix and publish unblock.
